question: Should memory-wiki vault isolation be implemented through a generic per-agent plugin config contract, a memory-wiki-specific per-agent vault mapping/templating contract, or deferred until the broader plugin config model is settled?
rationale: The code can support multiple approaches, but the choice changes public config shape, plugin SDK expectations, upgrade behavior, and sensitive-memory isolation semantics.

options.title: Define generic per-agent plugin config first
options.body: Add an approved agents.list[].plugins-style contract and make memory-wiki consume it, aligning this issue with the broader plugin configuration work.

options.title: Add a memory-wiki-owned vault map
options.body: Keep the generic plugin config model unchanged and add a narrower memory-wiki vault selection surface with explicit rules for agent/sessionless paths.

options.title: Defer this issue
options.body: Leave the global vault behavior documented until maintainers are ready to design the wider plugin/config isolation model.

recommendation.title: Define generic per-agent plugin config first
recommendation.body: Add an approved agents.list[].plugins-style contract and make memory-wiki consume it, aligning this issue with the broader plugin configuration work.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans plugin config, public docs, memory isolation, and upgrade policy rather than only one memory-wiki implementation file.
